name: AI Job Listing
author: Axilweb Limited

sections.description:
AI Job Listing is a powerful WordPress plugin that allows you to create and manage professional job listings on your website. With AI-powered description generation, you can quickly create detailed job postings without the hassle of writing everything manually.

Whether you’re a recruiter, HR professional, or business owner, this plugin streamlines your hiring process with an intuitive interface and powerful features.

Key Features

AI-Powered Job Description Generation

Generate professional job descriptions using artificial intelligence based on your job attributes like title, location, department, and more.

Custom Job Attributes

Define and manage custom attributes for your job listings including job types, departments, locations, and more.

Advanced Search and Filtering

Allow job seekers to easily find relevant positions with advanced search and filtering options.

Responsive Design

Ensures your job listings look great on all devices, from desktops to mobile phones.

Application Management

Track and manage job applications directly from your WordPress dashboard.

Email Notifications

Receive notifications when new applications are submitted.

Privacy Notice

This plugin does not collect or store any personal data from users or site visitors by default.

If you enable the AI-based job description generation feature, job attributes (title, location, department, etc.) are sent to an external service (OpenAI) for processing. No personally identifiable information (PII) is shared.

This plugin complies with GDPR guidelines by requiring user consent via manual API key entry in the settings panel.

Compatibility

  • WordPress 5.8+
  • PHP 7.4 or higher (PHP 8.0+ recommended)
  • Modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge)

Security & Performance

  • Secure input validation and sanitization
  • Capability checks for admin features
  • Prevention of SQL injection vulnerabilities
  • Smart caching to improve performance
  • PSR-4 autoloading with modern OOP practices

Contributions

We welcome your suggestions and improvements!

sections.installation:
1. Upload the entire ai-job-listing directory to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Configure the plugin settings by navigating to the ‘Settings’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Begin creating job listings from the dedicated dashboard!
sections.faq:
How do I create a job listing?

Once the plugin is activated, navigate to the ‘Job Listings’ menu in the WordPress admin dashboard. From there, you can add new job listings and manage existing ones.

Does this plugin require any external services?

The AI description generation feature connects to the OpenAI API. This is optional and only used when you choose to generate descriptions.

Is there a limit to how many job listings I can create?

No, you can create as many job listings as you need.

Can I customize the application form?

Yes, the application form can be customized to collect the information most relevant to your hiring process.

How do job seekers apply for positions?

Job seekers can apply directly through your website using the application form attached to each job listing.

Does this work with my existing theme?

Yes, the plugin is designed to work with most WordPress themes.
